en.hubeali:
And from him, from Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Al Nazar Bin Suweyd, from Aasim Bin Humeyd, from Abu Baseer, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘The one who claims that Allah<sup>azwj</sup> is from a thing, or in a thing, or upon a thing, so he has Blasphemed’. I said, ‘Explain it to me’. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘I<sup>asws</sup> mean by the emerging from the thing for Him<sup>azwj</sup>, of by the attachment to it, or from a thing preceding Him<sup>azwj</sup>’.

And in another report, ‘(He<sup>asws</sup> said): ‘The one who claims that Allah<sup>azwj</sup> is from a thing, so he has Made Him<sup>azwj</sup> as an occurrence; and the one who claims that He<sup>azwj</sup> is in a thing, so he has Made Him<sup>azwj</sup> as contained; and the one who claims that He<sup>azwj</sup> is upon a thing, so he has Made Him<sup>azwj</sup> to be a Carried One’.
